_meta.description: Seasonal dungeon gear sets from the eog.gg database tab (Seasons 1-5): dungeon, gear name, 2-piece and 4-piece effects, the texts of the bracketed trigger effects, and the list of 31 dungeons by kingdom and rank band. Dungeon, gear and set names here are eog's translations (e.g. 'Yomi Pavilion' = Hellhold, 'General's Mausoleum' = Warlord's Rest); see sources/notes/eog.md for the name mapping. kind = gear_set | trigger_effect | dungeon.

records.name: Fire Ring
records.text: Deal Fire damage once to all enemies within 2 tiles of you.

records.name: Auto Defense
records.text: Grant yourself a shield based on 3% of max HP.

records.name: Emergency Protection
records.text: The first time you take fatal damage, your HP is forced to remain at 1, you recover 12% of max HP, and damage taken is reduced by 80%. Lasts until the end of your turn and cannot be removed.

records.name: Earth Fire
records.text: Apply Burning to the terrain within 1 tile of you.

records.name: Raid
records.text: Deal Physical damage once to all enemies within 1 tile of you.

records.name: Qi Break
records.text: Deal additional Wind damage once to the enemy hit by the battle skill attack.

records.name: Lightning Strike
records.text: Deal Light damage once to a single enemy.

records.name: Wind Shield
records.text: Grant yourself a shield based on 25% of max HP.

records.name: Energy Absorption
records.text: Heal yourself once.

records.name: Summon: Fang Thunder Beast
records.text: Summon a Fang Thunder Beast in front and have it act immediately. The familiar inherits a portion of the character's stats and remains on the battlefield for up to 5 turns.

records.name: Tenacity
records.text: Deal Dark damage 3 times to the target attacking you.

records.name: Immovable Mountain
records.text: Cannot be knocked back or pulled. Lasts until the end of your turn.

records.name: Purify
records.text: Remove one status ailment or debuff applied to you.

records.name: Spirit Stride
records.text: Increase your movement by 2 tiles. Cannot be removed.

records.name: Soul Devour
records.text: Heal yourself once.

records.name: Preemptive Strike
records.text: Advance the action order of the ally with the highest ATK by 20%.

records.name: Spirit Pact Echo
records.text: Reduce the cooldown of one random battle skill on cooldown by 1 turn.

records.name: Water Burst
records.text: Deal Water damage once to all enemies within a 1-tile square area around you.

records.name: Scarecrow
records.text: Summon a Scarecrow in front. The familiar inherits a portion of the character's stats and remains on the battlefield for up to 5 turns.

records.name: Mad Shark Gluttony
records.text: Deal Water damage once to all enemies within 2 tiles of the enemy hit by the battle skill attack. For each 5% the target's HP drops, this skill's damage increases by 5%, up to 50%.

records.name: Divination
records.text: Gain one random buff: either +15% final damage or 15% final damage reduction. Lasts 4 turns and cannot be removed.

records.name: Thornvine
records.text: Deal 150% Physical damage once to an enemy.

records.name: Insight
records.text: Increase your accuracy by 15%. Lasts 1 turn, up to 3 stacks.

records.name: Fortitude
records.text: Increase your CRIT Resistance by 15%. Lasts 1 turn, up to 3 stacks.

records.name: Resonance
records.text: For each of your familiars on the battlefield, increase your ATK by 20%. Up to 3 stacks, cannot be removed.

records.name: Whirlwind
records.text: Deal 70% Wind damage once to the enemy that attacked you and all enemies within 1 tile of it.

records.name: Recoil
records.text: Deal 80% Dark damage once to the enemy that inflicted a status ailment or debuff on you.

records.name: Resolve
records.text: Increase the ATK of all allies within 3 tiles of you by 15%. Lasts 2 turns.

records.name: Ghostfire Bloom
records.text: Deal 600% Dark damage once to all enemies within 2 tiles of you.

records.name: Scorch
records.text: When you gain this state, at the start of your turn, when your movement ends, or when an enemy enters the area, deal 70% Fire damage once to all enemies within a 1-tile square area around you.

records.name: Surging Will
records.text: Advance the action order of all allies within 3 tiles of you by 50%.

records.name: Kinetic Impact
records.text: Deal 200% Physical damage once to all enemies within a 1x3 tile area in front of you.

records.name: Summon: Forest Wolf Shield Soldier
records.text: Summon a Forest Wolf Shield Soldier in front and have it act immediately. The familiar inherits a portion of the character's stats and remains on the battlefield for up to 5 turns.

records.name: Ghostfire
records.text: Deal additional Dark damage once to the enemy hit by the battle skill attack.

records.name: Dark Flame
records.text: Apply Burning to the terrain on the tile where the single target enemy stands.

records.name: First Aid
records.text: Damage you take is reduced and the healing you provide is increased. Up to 5 stacks, cannot be removed.

records.name: Flying Thorn
records.text: Deal Physical damage once to a single enemy within 3 tiles of you.

records.name: Guardian Spirit
records.text: Deal Physical damage once to the enemy attacking you and all enemies within 1 tile of it.

records.name: War Feeds War
records.text: When you use a damage-dealing battle skill, gain a life steal effect. Lasts 2 turns and cannot be removed.

records.name: Power Charge
records.text: The next time you use a damage-dealing battle skill, CRIT Rate is increased. Up to 10 stacks.

records.name: Holy Heal
records.text: Heal yourself once for 6% of the HP you have lost.
